reference_title: UFC 3-301-01, Structural Engineering (DoD, dated 11 April 2023, as amended through Change 4, 3 June 2025)

sections.title: Highway Bridge Design
sections.summary: Design of highway bridges is required to be in accordance with the AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications; design examples are available in the PCI Bridge Design Manual and at the FHWA links given (LRFD Design Examples, Reference Manual).
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of highway bridges is required to be in accordance with AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications. Design examples are available in the PCI Bridge Design Manual and the following links • LRFD Design Examples (https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/bridge/lrfd/examples.cfm) • Reference Manual (https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/bridge/pubs/nhi15047.pdf)
key_points: Design of highway bridges is required to be in accordance with AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications (p. 85)
Design examples are available in the PCI Bridge Design Manual and the FHWA links given (p. 85)

sections.title: Railroad Bridge Design
sections.summary: Railroad bridges are designed to the AREMA Manual for Railway Engineering.
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of railroad bridges is required to be in accordance with the AREMA Manual for Railway Engineering.
key_points: Design of railroad bridges is required to be in accordance with the AREMA Manual for Railway Engineering (p. 85)

sections.title: Tanks for Liquid Storage
sections.summary: Design of tanks for liquid storage is required to be in accordance with NFPA 22, AWWA D100, AWWA D103, AWWA D107, AWWA D115, AWWA D110 and AWWA D120 as applicable.
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of tanks for liquid storage is required to be in accordance with NFPA 22, AWWA D100, AWWA D103, AWWA D107, AWWA D115, AWWA D110 and AWWA D120 as applicable.
key_points: Design of tanks for liquid storage is required to be in accordance with NFPA 22, AWWA D100, D103, D107, D115, D110 and D120 as applicable (p. 85)

sections.title: Tanks for Petroleum Storage
sections.summary: Petroleum storage tanks are designed to UFC 3-460-01.
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of tanks for petroleum storage is required to be in accordance with UFC 3-460-01.
key_points: Design of tanks for petroleum storage is required to be in accordance with UFC 3-460-01 (p. 85)

sections.title: Environmental Engineering Concrete Structures
sections.summary: Design of environmental engineering concrete structures is required to be in accordance with ACI CODE-350.
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of environmental engineering concrete structures is required to be in accordance with ACI CODE-350.
key_points: Design of environmental engineering concrete structures is required to be in accordance with ACI CODE-350 (p. 85)

sections.title: Prestressed Concrete Tanks
sections.summary: Prestressed concrete tanks are designed to ACI 372R.
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of prestressed concrete tanks is required to be in accordance with ACI 372R.
key_points: Design of prestressed concrete tanks is required to be in accordance with ACI 372R (p. 85)

sections.title: Water Treatment Facilities
sections.summary: Water treatment facility structures are designed to the Water Environment Federation's Manual of Practice 8.
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of water treatment facilities is required to be in accordance with the Water Environment Federation (WEF) Manual of Practice (MOP) 8.
key_points: Design of water treatment facilities is required to be in accordance with the Water Environment Federation (WEF) Manual of Practice (MOP) 8 (p. 85)

sections.title: Transmission Towers and Poles
sections.summary: Transmission towers follow ASCE 10; transmission poles follow the IEEE National Electric Safety Code.
sections.body: [p. 85] Design of transmission towers is required to be in accordance with ASCE 10. Design of transmission poles is required to be in accordance with IEEE Standards Association’s National Electric Safety Code.
key_points: Design of transmission towers is required to be in accordance with ASCE 10 (p. 85)
Design of transmission poles is required to be in accordance with IEEE Standards Association’s National Electric Safety Code (p. 85)

sections.title: Antenna Towers
sections.summary: Design of antenna towers is required to be in accordance with ANSI/TIA-222-H.
sections.body: [p. 86] Design of antenna towers is required to be in accordance with ANSI/TIA-222-H.
key_points: Design of antenna towers is required to be in accordance with ANSI/TIA-222-H (p. 86)

sections.title: Pedestrian Bridges
sections.summary: Pedestrian bridges are designed to the AASHTO LRFD Guide Specifications for Design of Pedestrian Bridges.
sections.body: [p. 86] Design of pedestrian bridges is required to be in accordance with the AASHTO LRFD Guide Specifications for Design of Pedestrian Bridges.
key_points: Design of pedestrian bridges is required to be in accordance with the AASHTO LRFD Guide Specifications for Design of Pedestrian Bridges (p. 86)
